extracted.summary: Daniel, currently unrepresented in divorce proceedings, asks to borrow about £18,000 to instruct a solicitor, with around £130,500 of matrimonial assets (house and pension) in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for getting in touch with Lodestar Legal Finance about funding for your divorce. We have noted that you are currently representing yourself and that you have mentioned around £18,000 of funding and approximately £130,500 in assets. To take this further we would need to know where your proceedings are taking place, the current stage and any upcoming hearing dates, details of any solicitor you intend to instruct, and more information about the assets in dispute and how they are held. Once we have that we can review your enquiry and come back to you. Nothing in this message is an offer of funding or legal advice.
